en.text: Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, sin is covered.

zhSimplified.text: 得赦免其过、遮盖其罪的，

zhTraditional.text: 得赦免其過、遮蓋其罪的，

en.text: Blessed is the man to whom the LORD doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.

zhSimplified.text: 凡心里没有诡诈、耶和华不算为有罪的，

zhTraditional.text: 凡心裏沒有詭詐、耶和華不算為有罪的，

en.text: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.

zhSimplified.text: 黑夜白日，你的手在我身上沉重；

zhTraditional.text: 黑夜白日，你的手在我身上沉重；

en.text: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to the LORD, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.

zhSimplified.text: 为此，凡虔诚人都当趁你可寻找的时候祷告你；

zhTraditional.text: 為此，凡虔誠人都當趁你可尋找的時候禱告你；

en.text: You are my hiding place. will preserve me from trouble. will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.
I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.

zhSimplified.text: 我要教导你，指示你当行的路；

zhTraditional.text: 我要教導你，指示你當行的路；

en.text: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.

zhSimplified.text: 你不可像那无知的骡马，

zhTraditional.text: 你不可像那無知的騾馬，

en.text: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in the LORD.
Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!

zhSimplified.text: 你们义人应当靠耶和华欢喜快乐；

zhTraditional.text: 你們義人應當靠耶和華歡喜快樂；
